blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — GT Capital Holdings Inc.’s consolidated net income fell 10 percent to P23.3 billion in the first nine months of 2026 as economic growth slowed and high inflation weighed on consumer sentiment. On Thursday, the conglomerate pointed out in a disclosure that third-quarter gross domestic product growth was 2.1 percent.
